title: Concept Mobility Core
description: A four-image future-mobility concept series grounded in one plausible autonomous pod language.
creative_direction: Image 01 defines one original urban autonomous mobility pod with credible surfacing, glazing, and access logic. Images 02-04 depend on it and preserve the exact concept identity while shifting city context and product story.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-context-shift, 03-surface-study, 04-presentation-master. Queue may run later images concurrently after 01-reference-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
